decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposed conversion of the existing roof area to form an additional bedroom is considered acceptable as it would enhance the standard of accommodation provided within the flat and would not have a harmful impact upon the site itself or the street scene generally, complying to policies ENV-B 1.1 and H 6.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Conversion of existing roof area to form additional bedroom and installation of 3x roof lights to rear elevation of existing roof of first floor flat
